description: Manufacturer and model come directly from the OpenStreetMap tags manufacturer=Aero Vodochody and model=L-39 with aircraft:type "military;jet;fixed_wing". SUB-VARIANT NOT ESTABLISHED and deliberately blank — Lithuanian Air Force Albatroses were L-39ZA and L-39C but the node does not say which. No tactical number recorded; Lithuanian L-39s carry repeating two-digit numbers so none must be inferred. operator_country LT is asserted on the basis of the location on the approach to the Lithuanian Air Force base at Zokniai; if it proves to be an ex-Soviet airframe never taken on Lithuanian charge this should become RU
